payload.acceptance_criteria:
It reads session and subagent transcripts under the workspace slug.
It keeps each result by its own timestamp and reports undated ones, never file mtime.
It keeps one result per tool_use_id across copies and files.
It joins each error to its tool_use input, and folds a script throw into the inner call it follows.
It sorts errors into stable classes, so two errors that differ only in a path share one class.
It prints per project the count and one sample per class.
It prints the classes new since the last run from a state file, with a read-only flag.
payload.description:
## Context
When the Orchestrator collects tool-call incidents, I want a script that scans session transcripts for tool and script errors by class, so incidents are counted from the record and not from memory. Scope: .scripts/orch_errors.py and tests/test_orch_errors.py in lane harness/repair-orch-errors from main; it moves into .basicly/core/kit/orch/ after cut4 lands. Fixture transcripts use generic paths only, and the script starts no process. Requested by session repair under Orchestrator order 2026-11-19.
payload.title: Add orch errors to scan session transcripts for tool and script errors by class
